exact: venom-mediated vasodilation mediated by inhibition of angiotensin-converting enzyme
venom-mediated vasodilation through perturbation of angiotensin maturation

definition: A process in which an organism initiates, promotes, or enhances vasodilation via the action of a venom that prevents angiotensin maturation, concomittantly reducing blood pressure in the bitten/stung organism.
label: venom-mediated vasodilation via suppression of angiotensin maturation
